Ben / Team — reviewing Alex's notes and the attached draft. High‑level legal take and proposed contract language below. I attached a tracked‑changes MSA with inline comments (Redline_MSA_helio_v3_trackchanges.docx).

Summary:
- Pro‑rata billing: Acceptable. Proposed clause (Order Form / Billing section):
  "For any partial billing period resulting from a change in committed capacity mid‑period, Customer will be billed pro rata for the portion of the period during which such additional capacity was provided. Pro rata calculations shall be based on the list price of the additional units and computed on a daily basis, rounded to the nearest cent."

- Surge clause: We can support temporary surges with constraints to limit SLA exposure and pricing ambiguity. Proposed clause:
  "Temporary Surge: Customer may request temporary surge capacity up to 3x the committed baseline for a maximum continuous duration of seventy‑two (72) hours per occurrence, subject to prior notification to Redwood and capacity availability. Any usage above committed baseline during a Surge shall be billed at the published overage rate of $0.025 per token (or equivalent unit) for the duration of the Surge. If Customer maintains average usage above the committed baseline for a rolling 14‑day window, Redwood may treat such usage as a change to the committed capacity and adjust pricing accordingly upon notice."

Rationale and guardrails:
- We want a clear overage price and a mechanism to convert sustained surges into a committed uplift (protects our economics).
- Limit continuous duration and include an availability qualifier so we don't double‑book capacity.

Open items for sales/procurement to confirm:
1) Helio's internal signatory and whether they will accept our conversion trigger (14‑day rolling average).
2) Whether Helio needs different rounding rules or tax handling for pro‑rata.
3) Any specific reporting cadence procurement wants to see during Surges (we can provide daily surge usage reports).

Please review the attached redline and let me know if you want different thresholds or a lower overage price for strategic reasons; we can escalate for an exception if necessary.
